title: Dr. Ruth K.M. Pfau Civil Hospital Karachi
description: Largest government teaching hospital in Karachi with 1,900 beds. Provides free/subsidized treatment to over 90% of patients. Affiliated with Dow Medical College and offers comprehensive medical, surgical, and specialized services.
address: Markwick Road, Narayan Pura, Ranchore Line, Karachi, 74400, Sindh, Pakistan
eligibility: No documentation required for emergency services
application: Walk-in or direct admission. Take a token at reception counter. Emergency services available 24/7 without appointments.
source_name: Government of Sindh Health Department, Karachi Metropolitan Corporation

title: Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre (JPMC)
description: Oldest postgraduate medical education and research center in Pakistan with 1,600 beds. Public-private partnership model providing tertiary care. Affiliated with Sindh Medical College and Jinnah Sindh Medical University.
address: Rafiqui Shaheed Road, Karachi Cantonment, Karachi, 75510, Sindh, Pakistan
application: Visit emergency department or out-patient clinic. Book appointment through oladoc app or call helpline. Subsidized rates for low-income patients.

title: Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT)
description: Tertiary referral hospital specializing in nephrology, urology, dialysis, and kidney/organ transplantation. Founded by Dr. Adib Rizvi with mission 'We cannot let them die just because they cannot afford to live.' Provides all services completely free of cost.
address: Sardar Yaqoob Ali Khan Road, Near Civil Hospital, Karachi, 74000, Sindh, Pakistan
application: Direct walk-in to hospital or satellite centers. No appointment needed for initial consultation. Complete free treatment without any hidden charges.

title: National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (NICVD)
description: First tertiary cardiac care institute in South Asia. Flagship cardiology facility in Pakistan providing all cardiac services free of charge. Over 4,000 cardiac surgeries and 8,197 primary PCIs performed free. 8 satellite centers across Sindh.
address: Rafiqui (H.J.) Shaheed Road, Karachi Cantonment, Karachi, 75510, Sindh, Pakistan
application: Visit emergency department or outpatient clinic. Can book appointment through oladoc or walk-in. All diagnostic procedures and treatments completely free.

title: Abbasi Shaheed Hospital (KMU Teaching Hospital)
description: Third-largest government hospital in Karachi with 850 beds and 18 operation theaters. Established in 1974 under Prime Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto. Named after Major Ziauddin Abbasi. Teaching hospital for Karachi Metropolitan University.
address: Block 3 North Nazimabad/Sohail Road, Paposh Nagar, Karachi, 74700, Sindh, Pakistan
application: Walk-in to hospital. Take token at reception (no consultation charges). Emergency section open 24/7 without appointment.
source_name: Karachi Metropolitan University, City Government of Karachi

title: Indus Hospital & Health Network (Korangi Campus)
description: Non-profit welfare hospital providing 100% free-of-cost quality healthcare. 300-bed tertiary care facility established in 2007. Part of nationwide network with 12+ hospitals providing free services. Pakistan's first paperless and cashless hospital.
address: Plot C-76, Sector 31/5, Opposite Darussalam Society, Korangi Crossing, Karachi, 75190, Sindh, Pakistan
application: Visit hospital directly or call helpline 021-111-111-880. Complete registration and consultation free. No hidden charges. Computerized and cashless system ensures transparency.
source_name: Indus Hospital & Health Network Official Website

title: Civil Hospital Hyderabad (Liaquat University Hospital)
description: 2,200-bed tertiary care hospital in Hyderabad, Sindh. One of largest teaching hospitals affiliated with Liaquat University of Medical & Health Sciences. Established in 1881, serves Sindh and neighboring Balochistan.
phone_number: Available at Hyderabad District Health Office
eligibility: Regional patients from Sindh and Balochistan
application: Direct visit or referral from primary health centers. Register at reception. Subsidized rates for eligible patients.
source_name: Liaquat University of Medical & Health Sciences

title: Civil Hospital Sukkur (Ghulam Muhammad Mahar Medical College Hospital)
description: Major public teaching hospital established in 1880 during British Raj. Serves northern Sindh with 300 beds. Processes over 1 million outpatient visits annually. Free/low-cost services for large indigent population.
phone_number: Available at Sukkur District Health Office
eligibility: Northern Sindh, Lower Punjab, Balochistan patients
application: Walk-in or referral from primary health centers. Direct admission for emergency cases.

title: Civil Hospital Nawabshah (People's University Hospital)
description: 1,500-bed tertiary care hospital affiliated with People's University of Medical and Health Sciences. Established in 1915. Serves Sindh and Balochistan with free/subsidized services.
phone_number: Available at Nawabshah District Health Office
eligibility: Regional patients from Sindh and Balochistan
application: Direct visit or referral. Register at reception for subsidized/free treatment eligibility.
source_name: People's University of Medical & Health Sciences
